name: mapscraper
description: Extracts every asset a Source Engine / Garry's Mod map depends on (materials, textures, models, sounds, soundscapes, particles, misc files) from its VMF.
author: SpySpaille

scripts.test: node test/run.js && node test/features.js && node test/ux.js && node test/qol.js && node test/release.js
scripts.build: pkg . --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist/MapScraper.exe && node scripts/checksum.js dist/MapScraper.exe
